dataOrigin: synthetic; no product claims or real-person evidence

formatProfile.numbers: finite binary64; integers must be safe in JavaScript
formatProfile.negativeZero: numeric equality with zero; non-target bytes still preserved
formatProfile.lineEndings: LF or CRLF accepted; non-target bytes remain unchanged
formatProfile.schemaReferences: local fragment refs only; never fetch network or local paths

mutationProfile.missingTarget: target_missing; setField never inserts a missing field
mutationProfile.expectedAbsent: distinct from null; a missing setField target is still target_missing
mutationProfile.expectedValue: type-aware JSON equality, bool is not a number
mutationProfile.snapshot: all targets and expects resolve against the same baseline
mutationProfile.overlap: reject repeated targets; deeper or parent/child paths unsupported in v1
mutationProfile.candidateValidation: complete final candidate once, not each intermediate edit
mutationProfile.identityProtection: schemaVersion, title, sources and record ids/order are not mutable through revise
mutationProfile.noOp: unchanged; no new revision or effect claim
mutationProfile.recordInsertRemoveMove: unsupported in v1; later work package only

authority.schemaOwner: trusted ClawX domain registry, not model arguments
authority.mutationOwner: current runtime file-effect owner; SDK seam not implemented by TF-0244
authority.effectReceipt: correlation only; not authorization or replay truth
authority.uiMutationEntry: existing managed agent run via host-api/Main/Gateway
authority.idempotency: owner binds retry scope and payload digest; same key/different payload conflicts
authority.approvalBinding: artifact + base revision + candidate digest + effect scope; recheck after approval

limitsProposal.status: suggested trial limits, not production defaults or measured guarantees
limitsProposal.measurement: measure cold/warm latency and RSS in W1/W3; no claim these limits are attainable

resultSemantics.postCommitCancel: retain actual source outcome; never report zero effect if bytes changed
resultSemantics.lateRender: may retain historical output, must not move latest pointer backwards
resultSemantics.recovery: compare actual content to durable pre/post identities; never replay unknown effect
resultSemantics.restore: old snapshot is committed as a new revision against current base
